commentList.content: 1999年的金茂君悦年頭長了，降低了期望值。其實不錯的，門口迎賓主動開關車門拉出行李，前台儘量滿足要求，給了朝向浦西外灘的80層嘉賓軒江景房。房間保持新而整潔。行政酒廊下午茶的藍莓司康和核桃蛋糕不錯。咖啡機在最裡麪。晚間小食品質欠佳，吃了鹽漬三文魚。56樓早餐還行，走到最北面餐枱並向裏面看，有生煎包煎餃，味美。房間40平米，衞浴小而緊湊。但打卡值了，外觀及內飾都是三件套中最漂亮的。
commentList.translatedContent: Although the Grand Hyatt Jin Mao, built in 1999, is showing its age—which lowered our expectations—it actually turned out to be a great stay. The doormen actively opened car doors and retrieved our luggage. The front desk accommodated our requests as much as possible, upgrading us to a Grand Club River View Room on the 80th floor facing the Puxi Bund. The room was well-maintained, feeling fresh and clean. In the Executive Lounge, the afternoon tea's blueberry scones and walnut cake were quite good (the coffee machine is located in the innermost corner), though the evening canapés were of mediocre quality—I had the salted salmon. Breakfast on the 56th floor was decent; if you walk to the northernmost buffet station and look inside, you'll find freshly pan-fried buns (shengjianbao) and potstickers, which were delicious. The room is 40 square meters, and the bathroom is small and compact. Still, it's totally worth visiting for the experience—both its exterior and interior are the most stunning among the 'three major skyscrapers'.

feedbackList.content: 尊敬的賓客：感謝您帶着"降低期望值"的心態來打卡，卻給了我們一份如此坦誠又細緻的評價。1999年至今，能被您認可"外觀及內飾都是三件套中最漂亮的"，是對這座經典地標最好的迴響。迎賓與前台的用心已傳達至團隊，80層浦西江景房的視野沒讓您失望就好。嘉賓軒的藍莓司康和核桃蛋糕看來很合您口味，不過咖啡機位置隱蔽和晚間小食的品質問題，您的反饋已同步餐飲團隊，我們會盡快優化。56樓早餐的生煎包和煎餃確實值得"尋寶"，謝謝您替其他賓客指路。房間空間是時代的印記，但維護得"新而整潔"是我們一直堅持的底線。您説"打卡值了"，這比什麼都珍貴。期待下次您再來，行政酒廊會有更好的表現等您驗收。祝您旅途常伴好風景。上海金茂君悦大酒店 管理團隊 敬上
feedbackList.translatedContent: Dear Guest, Thank you for your honest and detailed review despite having lowered your expectations. Since 1999, your recognition that "the exterior and interior are the most beautiful of the three" is the best affirmation of this classic landmark. The dedication of the greeters and front desk staff has been conveyed to the team, and we are glad that the view from the 80th-floor Puxi river view room did not disappoint you. The blueberry scones and walnut cake in the Grand Hyatt Club seemed to suit your taste, but your feedback regarding the hidden location of the coffee machine and the quality of the evening snacks has been shared with the food and beverage team, and we will improve them as soon as possible. The pan-fried buns and dumplings at the 56th-floor breakfast are indeed worth the search; thank you for pointing them out to other guests. The room space bears the mark of its era, but maintaining it as "new and clean" is our consistent bottom line. Your comment that "it was worth the visit" is more precious than anything else. We look forward to your next visit; the Executive Lounge will have even better performance for you to see. We wish you continued success on your journey. Sincerely, The Management Team of Grand Hyatt Shanghai

commentList.content: ：和家人一起來住的金茂君悦，大家都挺滿意。地段便利，下樓商圈很近，去東方明珠、江邊走走都不遠。從禮賓到客房服務都很貼心，做事有分寸，不會過度打擾。房間隔音挺好，夜裡很安靜，衞生做得仔細，高空view是最大亮點，坐着看看窗外就很治癒，整體是很穩的五星體驗。
commentList.translatedContent: We stayed at the Grand Hyatt with our family, and everyone was quite satisfied. The location is very convenient, with shopping districts just downstairs, and walking to the Oriental Pearl Tower or the riverfront is not far at all. From the concierge to room service, the staff were thoughtful and attentive, handling things professionally without being overly intrusive. The room soundproofing is great, making for a very quiet night, and the housekeeping was meticulous. The high-altitude view is the biggest highlight—just sitting and looking out the window is so relaxing. Overall, it's a solid five-star experience.

feedbackList.content: 尊敬的賓客，您好！非常感謝您與家人選擇下榻上海金茂君悦大酒店，並抽出寶貴時間分享此次入住體驗。讀到您對酒店地段、禮賓與客房服務的認可，以及家人對整體旅程的滿意，我們管理團隊深感榮幸。地處陸家嘴核心商圈，步行即可抵達東方明珠與濱江大道，這份得天獨厚的便利一直是我們引以為傲的優勢。很高興我們的團隊服務能為您留下“貼心且有分寸”的印象——這正契合金茂君悦對五星服務的理解：在恰到好處的主動與剋制的優雅之間，為賓客營造真正鬆弛的居停氛圍。您特別提到的房間隔音與衞生細節，我們已同步至客房管家團隊，這是對我們日常運營標準的最佳肯定。當然，最令我們欣喜的莫過於您對高空城景的喜愛。坐擁黃浦江畔的雲端視野，俯瞰浦江兩岸的流光溢彩，本身就是一種治癒。得知這成為您與家人共度時光的温馨背景，我們倍感欣慰。期待在不久的將來，能再次迎接您與家人的歸來。屆時，無論是節日慶典還是閑暇小憩，上海金茂君悦大酒店始終會是您在滬上值得信賴的“家外之家”。祝您與家人順遂安康，旅途常伴美好。上海金茂君悦大酒店 管理團隊 敬上
feedbackList.translatedContent: Dear Guest, Thank you for choosing to stay at the Grand Hyatt Shanghai and taking the time to share your experience. We are honored to hear of your positive feedback on the hotel's location, concierge and room service, and your family's overall satisfaction with the trip. Located in the heart of the Lujiazui business district, within walking distance of the Oriental Pearl Tower and the Bund, this unparalleled convenience has always been a source of pride for us. We are delighted that our team's service left you with an impression of being "attentive yet measured"—a perfect reflection of the Grand Hyatt Shanghai's understanding of five-star service: creating a truly relaxing atmosphere for guests with just the right amount of proactive yet restrained elegance. Regarding your specific comments on the room's soundproofing and cleanliness, we have already shared them with the housekeeping team, which is the best affirmation of our daily operational standards. Of course, what pleases us most is your appreciation for the panoramic city views. Enjoying the view from the top of the Huangpu River, overlooking the dazzling lights on both sides, is a truly therapeutic experience. We are delighted to learn that this has become a warm backdrop for your time with your family. We look forward to welcoming you and your family back in the near future. Whether it's a festive celebration or a leisurely retreat, the Grand Hyatt Shanghai will always be your trusted "home away from home" in Shanghai. Wishing you and your family good health and happiness, and may your journeys be filled with joy. Sincerely, The Management Team, Grand Hyatt Shanghai

commentList.content:
Pro’s: great location, amazing views from lobby and breakfast, and overall feeling of luxury across the hotel.

Cons: The luxury vibes are immediately contrasted and opaqued by the old outdated looks of the room, and the lack of amenities (i.e.: you get a bathtub that looks good, but no bubble bath liquid/gel, and when you request it, they don’t have. They only offer bath salts).
The coffee machine was plugged to a wall plug that didn’t work, so as soon as we arrived in the room wanting a hot coffee to deal with the outside cold, we had to call maintenance (plug couldn’t be taken out due to a glass tray it was passed through, otherwise I would’ve connected it myself to another wall plug) to come and try another plug.
The wifi was also not working at all and after 20 minutes on the phone with the IT staff and no solution, we gave up on using it (cut off in the middle of a show we were watching, which was very frustrating).
The overall staff at the hotel (specifically the breakfast) does not smile at you, and they seem to be overworked and stressed of dealing with the guests, with one exception (the lady chef making the wonton soup. She was lovely and smiling).
Lastly, I specifically paid a lot for this room to celebrate our trip and have nice views of the iconic TV tower on our last night in China, so I requested a high floor room, and was very disappointed to see that they put us in a room that LITERALLY had a huge lightning rod/antenna with a whole roofing next to the whole window, making the view blocked and ugly with the old rusty and dirty metal, completely opaque and dissatisfying .

Honestly I would not recommend this hotel to anyone at all. They charge a whole lot (we paid USD 500 for one night) and it doesn’t make you feel welcomed or cared for.

feedbackList.content: Dear Valued Guest,Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed and honest feedback. We are truly sorry your celebratory last night in China didn't feel as special as it should have — especially at this price point. That is on us, and we have taken every word to heart.Perched within the iconic Jin Mao Tower — one of Lujiazui's original "Three-Piece Set" — Grand Hyatt Shanghai has been welcoming guests above the clouds for nearly 27 years. Our unique architectural language, inspired by a traditional Chinese pagoda rising through the sky, is something we are incredibly proud of. But we know that heritage alone doesn't make a stay memorable — it's how you feel the moment you step into your room.About the view: we completely understand your disappointment. You chose us for that iconic skyline, and we want every guest to feel the same thrill you expected. Moving forward, we are placing even greater care on room assignment — taking the time to truly understand each guest's view preferences and doing everything we can to match them. Your experience has reminded us that a great view isn't a perk here; it's a promise, and we are committed to keeping it.On the practical side, your notes on the missing bubble bath, the temperamental power outlet, the Wi-Fi drop, and the breakfast team's strained smiles have all been shared with our General Manager and the relevant departments. These are being reviewed and improved this week — because 27 years in the clouds means we should know how to make things effortless by now.Thank you for giving us your honesty. We hope that one day, when you think of Shanghai, you will give us another chance to show you the warm, seamless stay you should have had this time — with a view that truly takes your breath away.Warm regards,The Management TeamGrand Hyatt Shanghai

commentList.content: 帶媽媽去上海玩，訂東方明珠景觀大床房，很失望，感覺訂這個酒店就是浪費錢，唯一的優點：樓層高，可以看夜景但景觀也一般般，房間的設施很陳舊感，像十八線城市的賓館的裝潢，紙巾又很差，屬於你洗完手，拿來擦手，會全粘在手上的那種超差紙巾，浴室衹有直對着頭的淋浴，沒有手拿花灑，衹有在浴缸位置一個短短的花灑.預訂的時候已經提前告知的，不靠近電梯，明確要求不靠近電梯，可是給我安排靠電梯的第一間（前台告知我，靠電梯的房間更好看東方明珠景，所以我後面要求，那就給我隔一兩間，給我靠電梯的第二間或者第三間），沒想到是第一間，而且看東方明珠還要站在側玻璃，斜着看！酒店説明下午3:00可以辦理入住，3:50到酒店，告訴我們阿姨還在打掃衞生，沒有房！因為沒有房間，我們就出去玩，回來已經是八點多了，就不想再換房！
commentList.translatedContent:
Took my mom on a trip to Shanghai and booked the Oriental Pearl View King Room. I was very disappointed and felt like booking this hotel was a complete waste of money. The only advantage is the high floor, offering a night view, but even the view is just so-so. The room facilities feel very dated, resembling the decor of a budget hotel in a small town. The tissues are of extremely poor quality—the kind that shreds and sticks all over your hands when you try to dry them after washing. The bathroom only has a fixed overhead rain shower with no handheld showerhead, except for a short one placed by the bathtub.

I had informed them in advance during booking and made a clear request not to be near the elevator. Yet, they assigned me the very first room right next to the elevator (the front desk claimed that rooms near the elevator actually have a better view of the Oriental Pearl, so I compromised and asked to be moved just one or two doors down, perhaps the second or third room from the elevator). To my surprise, they still kept me in the very first room, and to top it off, you have to stand by the side window and look at the Oriental Pearl at an angle!

The hotel states that check-in is available at 3:00 PM. We arrived at the hotel at 3:50 PM, only to be told the housekeeping auntie was still cleaning and the room wasn't ready! Because the room wasn't ready, we went out to sightsee. By the time we got back, it was already past 8:00 PM, so we just didn't bother changing rooms anymore.

feedbackList.content: 尊敬的賓客：讀完您的留言，我們心裏很不是滋味。帶母親出遊本該是件開心的事，卻因為我們的疏漏讓您和母親受了委屈，我們向您和母親深深致歉。您提到的每一個問題，我們都已認真記下並同步至前廳、客房及工程部門逐項核查整改。房型安排與您的溝通承諾不一致、用品品質未達底線、入住時效延誤——這些都不是您該承受的，我們絕不迴避。金茂君悦坐落於陸家嘴"三件套"之一的金茂大廈，佔據其獨有的雲端地標位置。正因其特殊的建築語言，每間客房的視野與格局各有不同——這本是我們引以為傲的特色，卻在此次未能轉化為您和母親眼前的美好。我們將進一步優化房型分配機制，讓這份建築之美真正匹配每一位賓客的期待。您願意花時間寫下這些，是對我們最大的信任。我們真心希望，在未來的某一天，當您和母親再次踏上上海的土地，能以一間真正無可挑剔的房間、一份恰到好處的温暖，重新走進您的心裏。祝您和母親安康喜樂，歲歲常相伴。上海金茂君悦大酒店管理團隊 敬上
feedbackList.translatedContent: Dear Guest: We are deeply saddened to have read your message. Traveling with your mother should have been a joyous occasion, but our oversight caused you and your mother inconvenience, for which we sincerely apologize. We have carefully noted down every issue you raised and have forwarded them to the front desk, housekeeping, and engineering departments for verification and rectification. The discrepancy between the room arrangement and your initial promises, the substandard quality of amenities, and the delayed check-in—these are not things you should have to endure, and we will not shirk our responsibilities. The Grand Hyatt is situated in the Jin Mao Tower, one of the "three pillars" of Lujiazui, occupying a unique landmark location. Due to its distinctive architectural style, each room offers a unique view and layout—a feature we are proud of, but unfortunately, it failed to translate into the enjoyment you and your mother experienced. We will further optimize our room allocation system to ensure that this architectural beauty truly matches the expectations of every guest. Your willingness to take the time to write this message is the greatest trust you can place in us. We sincerely hope that one day in the future, when you and your mother set foot on Shanghai soil again, a truly impeccable room and just the right amount of warmth will rekindle your love. Wishing you and your mother good health and happiness, and that you will be together forever. Sincerely, The Management Team of Grand Hyatt Shanghai

summaryItemList.conclusion: The hotel is centrally located in Lujiazui, close to attractions and public transport, with views of landmarks like the Oriental Pearl Tower.(based on 5,343 reviews)

summaryItemList.title: Room Quality
summaryItemList.conclusion: Rooms are spacious and clean, with comfortable beds and soundproofing. High floors offer stunning Shanghai views.(based on 4,020 reviews)

summaryItemList.title: Service
summaryItemList.conclusion: Staff are professional and friendly, with bilingual service and efficient check-in/out, enhancing the experience.(based on 6,421 reviews)

summaryItemList.title: Amenities
summaryItemList.conclusion: Amenities include a pool and spa. The club lounge offers quality snacks, and the breakfast buffet has diverse options.(based on 524 reviews)

summaryItemList.title: Guest Suggestion
summaryItemList.conclusion: Some customers suggest improving check-in efficiency, enhancing staff training, and better maintenance and cleanliness of facilities.(based on 456 reviews)

sceneSummaryItemList.conclusion: The hotel offers breathtaking city and river views from high floors, including landmarks like the Bund and Oriental Pearl Tower. Breakfast features diverse options, from European to Asian cuisines, served with stunning views. Conveniently located near metro stations and attractions, making city exploration easy.
